Gillespie adds 13.2 points, 4.8 assists and 4.2 rebounds per game, and Oso Ighodaro contributes with 6.2 points, 2.2 assists and 4.9 rebounds per outing. Among active players, the Suns are led by Gillespie from long distance. He hits 3.0 shots from deep per game. Gillespie averages 1.3 steals per game. Ighodaro collects 0.6 blocks an outing. Bucks The Bucks go-to guy, Ryan Rollins, leads active Bucks players in both scoring (16.8 points per game) and assists (5.6 assists per game). Bobby Portis has per-game averages of 13.7 points, 1.6 assists and 6.4 rebounds this season. AJ Green makes 2.8 treys per game.
